# Interface Components: Scene3DCanvas

# Scene3DCanvas

Use `geometryReadOnly` when a separate classification workflow owns writes: it blocks object authoring, drag, numeric, precision and keyboard edits without disabling classification or scene navigation. `readOnly` always takes precedence.

Access through window.InterfaceComponents.Scene3DCanvas. The controlled regions use type "labels" and _value with x/y/z centre, l/w/h dimensions in metres, yaw/pitch/roll in degrees. Z is up; yaw is measured from +Y toward +X. Pass activeLabels, labelColors, fromName and toName for new cuboids. Do not pass 2D percentage boxes.

- **Pass shell state straight through.** `props.regions` already uses the canonical shape, so filter it to this canvas (`r._toName === TO_NAME`) and pass it as `regions`. Wire `selectedRegionIds={props.selectedRegionIds}`, `onAddRegion={props.addRegion}`, `onUpdateRegion={props.updateRegion}`, `onDeleteRegion={props.deleteRegion}`, `onSelectRegion={(id, opts) => props.selectRegion(id, opts)}` (a `null` id clears the selection).
- **Created regions are complete.** The canvas stamps `activeLabels` → `labels`, `labelColors` → `colors`, and `fromName`/`toName` → `_fromName`/`_toName`. Do not rebuild or re-id them in the screen. Always pass the same `labelColors` map you give the LabelPicker.
- **No Delete buttons in slots.** `onDeleteRegion` is for the canvas's own delete gestures. The shell already renders Lock / Hide / Delete around `InfoViewer` and `OutlinerItem`, so those exports render content only — never a "Delete polygon" / "Delete box" / trash button (FIT-2931).
- **Never discard unlabeled regions.** If nothing is selected in the LabelPicker the region is created with `labels: []`; relabel it later with `props.updateRegion(id, { labels, colors })` (always update `colors` with `labels`).
- **Hydrate with colors.** In `parseResults`, pass `{ labelColors }` into `from*Results` (or stamp `colors` afterward). The Regions panel has no `labelColors` fallback — empty `colors` means gray chips.
- **Do not show the in-canvas LayerManager.** `showLayers` defaults to false. Leave it off (and do not mount `*.LayerManager`) — the editor-shell Outliner / Regions panel is the region list.

```jsx
function Scene(props) {
  return <window.InterfaceComponents.Scene3DCanvas
    regions={props.regions} selectedRegionIds={props.selectedRegionIds}
    activeLabels={["Vehicle"]} labelColors={{}} fromName="cuboids" toName="scene"
    onAddRegion={props.addRegion} onUpdateRegion={props.updateRegion}
    onDeleteRegion={props.deleteRegion} onSelectRegion={props.selectRegion}
    readOnly={props.readOnly} hotkeys={props.hotkeys} settings={props.settings}
    relationLinkingSource={props.relationLinkingSource}
  />;
}
function getResults(regions) {
  return window.InterfaceComponents.Scene3DCanvas.toScene3DResults(regions);
}
function parseResults(results) {
  return window.InterfaceComponents.Scene3DCanvas.fromScene3DResults(results);
}
({ default: Scene, getResults, parseResults });
```

fromScene3DResults(results) reads cuboid-valued labels results, including LiDAR keyframes. toScene3DResults(regions, {fromName, toName}) preserves imported envelopes, provenance, precision and absent labels keys. These helpers only own individual cuboid results. For the complete legacy document, use fromSceneDocumentResults(results, {classes,toName}) and toSceneDocumentResults(document), which retain tracks, properties, native camera records, masks, review metadata, relations and unknown recovery data. projectSceneDocumentCuboids(document, frame, {frames}) derives an interpolated cuboid view; patchSceneDocumentCuboid(document,id,frame,pose,{frames}) writes an exact anchor without flattening the document.

frame selects exact frame-bound regions plus unbound static regions; itemIndex and toName scope objects. No automatic interpolation, prediction acceptance, timestamp conversion or frame advancement. pointCloud contains decoded world XYZ, optional color and per-point sensorIds. Precision queries use the supplied source points, before display sampling; display sampling never rewrites point identity. rosBag takes precedence over pointCloud. Pass a stable, non-secret id (never a signed URL). A worker reads indexes and fetches only the selected topic/time; HTTP sources MUST serve 206 ranges and expose Content-Range through CORS. Local File/Blob sources are sliced. Supports ROS 1 none/LZ4/BZ2 and MCAP none/LZ4/Zstd. Reads/chunks above 64 MiB and cumulative reads/decompression above 192 MiB per operation fail with a rechunking message. Rapid seeks cancel/coalesce; stale clouds are cleared and annotation edits are blocked while loading. New cuboids preserve _value.rosBag {id,topic,logTimeNanoseconds,stampNanoseconds,frameId} and only appear for that message. onRosBagMetadata supplies topics/duration; onRosBagFrame supplies sampled positions, original sourceIndices and exact string timestamps. PointCloud2 coordinates stay in header.frame_id; no implicit TF transform. No MCAP indexing in the browser; no direct SQLite .db3 support (convert with ros2 bag convert). The native source worker also reads legacy scene.json/KLF and LAS/LAZ/COPC with bounded caches and paged original-point queries. Native LAS/LAZ residency defaults to 4M points, COPC to 250k; explicit pointBudget supports up to 16M. displayBytes is a peak source allocation ceiling (default 2 GiB) and reports an explicit error instead of silently clipping. sceneSource.debug.startDelayMs delays initial dispatch abortably; sceneSource.debug.noWorkers runs the same source protocol on the main thread for diagnostics only. Host adapters must gate both behind debugHooks. COPC starts with up to eight hierarchy nodes and refines visible detail explicitly or progressively. Never substitute fake scene data when a source fails.

Scene3DCanvas.Workspace accepts document, frame, context:{frameCount,frames:[{index,t}]}, revision, selectedRegionIds, onSelectRegion, onFrameChange and onChangeDocument(next,{label,expectedDocument,expectedRevision,signal}). Timestamps are seconds; frame indices are one-based. The host must reject aborted signals or stale revisions and apply each document edit atomically using its existing history. Workspace never stores canonical annotations; pending writes disable further edits, and rejection reports an error. It composes the point/path/lane layer and Scene temporal controls with the cuboid viewport. activeClassId/onActiveClassChange select creation ontology; static paths and static point classes span the sequence. showTimeline, propertyFields, foldSource, foldCloud and syncGroup configure the temporal surface. The copied controls expose keyframe edits, visibility ranges, static/keyframed properties, track corrections and explicit Fold preview/apply. Host integration and complete parity validation remain in progress.

showObjectViews initializes an object grid with top/back/right object-aligned panes with shared live previews, committed geometry and selection. The source is decoded once, including ROS. objectView chooses a standalone top/front/back/right pane; its view.target is a world offset from the object and view.span controls framing. Dragging in these panes moves in the camera plane, including elevation. Each pane owns its camera; only the focused pane handles shortcuts.


layout/onLayoutChange controls main, split and object grid views with independent paneViews and shared source/frame/selection/live geometry previews. Sources are lidar, top/back/right, or cam:<id>. availableCameras and renderCameraPane compose actual camera views; disabled/missing sources remain explicit. Pane dividers resize, maximize restores its prior layout, and layoutPresets/onLayoutPresetsChange store layout/view/color/appearance preferences without annotations. fullscreenTargetRef must refer to the whole host workspace. inspectorContainer moves the active numeric cuboid/node/path/point editor into a host Info panel without constructing a second controller.

objectSelection supplies canonical document/contextKey/hiddenIds/onChange for marquee. selectionMode/onSelectionModeChange selects click or marquee; Ctrl/Meta+Shift-drag is the supplemental marquee gesture, Shift-drag still pans, and Ctrl/Meta+Alt-click cycles committed overlaps before predictions. onScenePreview emits disposable exact-document/context/frame-bound cuboid or geometry drafts and clears them on cancellation or commit; camera composition can render a previewDocument without replacing its canonical edit base. decimals (default 2, range 0–4) changes displayed precision only; staticRadius (default 1.5 m) applies the original stationary XY clamp and first-anchor-following drag behavior.

pointLod/onPointLodChange controls original automatic main-pane stride and manual GPU pressure simulation; onRenderStats exposes coalesced source/drawn counts, stride and CPU paint time. Point identities, full queries and annotations remain unchanged. pointAppearance/onPointAppearanceChange controls original point size/attenuation/min-max pixels, opacity, selectedEmphasis (color/size/off) and background. Classification/searchlight colors retain priority over selection emphasis. classificationMemoryBudget/onClassificationMemoryBudgetChange controls packed range and canonical publication byte budgets; range workers preserve exact selection and expose allocation failures instead of clipping. colorPresets/onColorPresetsChange persist color preferences; sensors and sliceDefault expose supplied source options. cameraMode (static, follow_ego, follow_selected), navigationModel (orbit, fly), gridMode, overlayContext/overlaySettings and measurementState have matching change callbacks. Follow/fly and tape measurement remain available in read-only mode. aggregatePointCloud is display-only and must contain a bounded world-registered aggregate; original active-frame queries still drive fitting, picking and classification. cameraHover and quickProjection require exact host-verified source/frame/calibration proofs. worldPick and groundPick are transient callbacks, not annotation mutations.

Workspace exposes diagnosticsRef for bounded adapter diagnostics, onHotkeysChange for controlled command preferences, hotkeyLocks for host-managed assignments, and onUndo/onRedo/canUndo/canRedo for host-owned history. The Commands panel offers Library, Original, Left hand and Kognic classic profiles, with conflict validation and fixed platform actions; applying a profile does not alter labels. allowCamera2d=false and allowCalibration=false retain source editing restrictions while preserving inspection and unrelated 3D editing.
Workspace's optional onCameraCommandTargetChange publishes the transient active image occurrence. Native hosts must block world copy/duplicate/paste commands for that target and camera-only objects, and route property writes through resolveSceneCameraCommandTarget / prepareSceneCameraPropertyCommand. The latter resolves exact current records and enforces native schema, source metadata and permissions; never redirect a stale camera target into world properties. Omitted shapeIds selects all current-image occurrences only for a camera-only object.

Camera workspace and review panes honor the host hotkeys and settings.enableHotkeys. Camera-native arrows move the selected control or outline by one source pixel (Shift: five); Shift+0/0 prepend/append native path controls. Review-only cameraReview* actions declare tile, page, property/value and inspected-object navigation in the manifest. These component-scoped actions never dispatch world-space geometry edits.

Workspace additionally supports showObjects/objectEditorContainer/objectListView, onSelectionChange, openingDocument, clipboard/onClipboardChange, cameraSource/showCameras, review/showReview/onValidated/liveValidation, showClassification, showContactSheet/contactSheetSource, enableFold/foldSource/foldCloud, pointVisibilityThreshold and copcAutoDetail/onCopcAutoDetailChange. Native contact sheets and Fold reuse the source worker/cache; external loaders must supply registered sources explicitly. seedPredictions is opt-in only after empty-annotation hydration; onSeeded records the new opening snapshot. Source-bound transactions preserve revision and exact-frame evidence. Internal transaction.onPrepared acknowledges canonical source/provenance normalization before host dispatch; adapters should preserve this callback and reject stale/aborted work before history updates. Registration never follows from a fallback ego path.

The source-backed classification workflow separates preview from Apply, persists original point identities and task coverage, and refuses incomplete query evidence. Review preserves exact prediction snapshots for accept/reject/reset, requires explicit targets for assist proposals and exposes feedback/validation issues. These are controlled document operations and must pass through one host history transaction. Full browser/source/host parity is tracked separately; do not infer complete legacy parity from component availability.

The inspector offers Fit to Points, Fit to Ground, Flip Heading, six face controls with In/Out/Snap, height slicing and inside/outside clipping. Point filters remain usable without selection. The original query scales complete dimensions: snap 0.9, fit 1.2, auto-adjust 1.0. Fitting uses the full supplied cloud; sampled ROS frames require the worker query path. Ground fitting currently uses groundZ and retains pitch/roll when the estimate is unreliable. Shift+F fits points; Shift+H flips heading.

transformMode is translate, scale, rotate or hidden; activeAxis is local x/y/z or null. G/S/R/H select control modes; X/Y/Z toggle axis constraints; Alt+Left/Right nudges the current local transform. The original gizmo supplies axis tips, six face handles, four anchored corners and yaw/pitch/roll rings. Alt-click a face snaps it; Alt-click the center fits all faces. Each drag previews locally and across object panes, then emits one controlled update. Ctrl/Meta-click an axis constrains later body drags.

pointCloud may carry attributes (intensity, timestamps in sweep milliseconds, frameIds, classIds, RGB, LAS RGB/classification), source identity/resolution and sourceIndices. pointColors configures the original ten attribute modes, ramps, intensity range/brightness/contrast/gamma/equalization, presets, hybrid mode and class overlay. Missing attributes are explicitly reported; display sampling always indexes original attribute slots. Camera/source adapters remain responsible for calibrated RGB and class ownership.

Insert/Add Cuboid creates at the view centre on groundZ. The cuboid tool uses center two-click/press-drag or side three-click placement with a rubber-band preview; Shift on the second center point enables manual width. Enter finishes, Backspace steps back and Escape cancels. Drag a box to move, its corner grip to resize length/width, or heading grip to rotate. Numeric pose fields also edit height/pitch/roll. Drag empty space to orbit, Shift-drag empty space to pan; BEV and object panes pan on ordinary empty-space drags. Dragging preserves selection; an empty-space click clears it on release. Alt-drag or right-drag navigates even over objects, Shift+Alt-drag/middle-drag pans, scroll zooms. Arrow keys nudge, PageUp/PageDown change elevation, Q/E change yaw, brackets select, F fits, 2 switches BEV. Hotkeys honor overrides and settings.enableHotkeys; inputs suppress them. Locks/readOnly block mutations while navigation and selection remain available. A canceled or stale drag never commits.
